hero.h1: Bathroom Remodeling Peoria AZ: Most Showers Done in 1 to 2 Days
hero.subheadline: AZ New Bath is a licensed, brother-run contractor that does bathrooms only. Most shower remodels take 1 to 2 days, you keep running water and a toilet throughout, and every remodel carries a lifetime warranty.

image.alt: Bathroom remodeling Peoria AZ: marble-look porcelain slab walls, wood double vanity, oval mirrors and brass sconces

paragraphs: AZ New Bath is a general contractor that does one job only: the bathroom remodeling Peoria AZ homeowners call about, from a single shower to a full overhaul. Crews also work across the Valley and up to Prescott and Sedona. Brothers Jon and Jeremy Sands started the company in 2007 and still answer calls, write estimates, source materials and install.

Their focus is materials that stand up to Arizona heat and hard water and take little scrubbing, such as large porcelain slabs with fewer grout lines. Jobs move fast. A shower remodel averages 1 to 2 days, and the company promises it will never leave you without running water or a toilet. One reviewer summed it up as an "amazing family company."

services.h2: Bath and shower remodels from the Peoria crew

items.name: Full Bathroom Remodels
items.blurb: A complete overhaul from the first sketch to the final touches: tubs and showers, flooring, vanities, mirrors, medicine cabinets and lighting. Design consultants help pick every piece, down to the tile and showerheads. The company's own schedules put a complete primary bath at around two weeks.

image.alt: Primary bathroom remodel in Arizona with a freestanding tub, glass shower with bench seat and white double vanities

items.name: Shower Remodels
items.blurb: New wall surfaces, fixtures, niches and glass, installed clean and dust-free. Depending on size and scope, a shower can be finished in as little as one day, and the average is 1 to 2 days. All products used carry a lifetime warranty.

image.alt: Shower remodel with white marble-look porcelain walls, a hex mosaic accent stripe, niche and matte black rain head

items.name: Tub-to-Shower Conversions
items.blurb: The old tub comes out and a walk-in shower goes in, built to your layout and finishes. It frees up floor space and removes the step-over that makes tubs risky for anyone with limited mobility. AZ New Bath handles everything from removal to the finished shower.

image.alt: Before and after of a tub-to-shower conversion by AZ New Bath in the Phoenix area

items.name: Porcelain Installation
items.blurb: Large porcelain slabs for shower walls, floors and vanity tops give a high-end look with fewer grout lines to clean. Buying directly from suppliers, without middlemen, keeps the price competitive, and the team helps you match slabs to your style and budget.

image.alt: Porcelain slab shower in white and gray veining with a frameless glass panel, handheld shower and patterned tile floor

items.name: Accessible Walk-In Showers
items.blurb: Walk-in showers and walk-in tubs for seniors and anyone with mobility needs, with options such as ramps, folding seats, grab bars and easy wheelchair access. Each one is still fully custom, so safety features sit inside a bathroom that looks finished rather than clinical.

image.alt: Accessible walk-in shower with a fold-down seat, black grab bar, recessed niche and pebble tile floor

why_choose_us.h2: Why West Valley homeowners call AZ New Bath

items.title: You keep a working bathroom
items.text: The company states it will never leave you without running water or a toilet. Most shower jobs wrap up in 1 to 2 days, so the disruption is short.

items.title: Lifetime warranty, satisfaction promised
items.text: Every remodel comes with a lifetime warranty on products and services. The team says it will keep working with you until you are 100% happy with the result.

items.title: Samples come to your home
items.text: A Google reviewer wrote that Wayne explained everything, showed the options and "had samples with him in person," which made picking the shower much easier.

items.title: Price match and 0% financing
items.text: AZ New Bath offers a price match guarantee and 0% financing, with transparent pricing and no hidden fees. Inquiries get a reply within 24 hours.

about.text: Jonathan Sands and his brother Jeremy started AZ New Bath during the 2007 recession. They saw that tile and cultured marble looked good at first but were hard to keep clean, so they built the business around low-maintenance products at a fair price. Jon is the owner and licensed contractor, and the brothers still work in the business every day. Evelyn Johnson schedules your consultation, design consultants Jay and Wayne guide selections, and installers like Chris and Daniel do the build.

image.alt: Jonathan Sands, owner and licensed contractor at AZ New Bath in Peoria, AZ

steps.title: Call or request a quote
steps.text: Evelyn sets up your free, no-obligation in-home consultation. The team aims to answer every inquiry within 24 hours.

steps.title: Analysis
steps.text: A consultant looks at the space and helps pick the right materials and products for how you use the bathroom and what you want to spend.

steps.title: Design
steps.text: Jay or Wayne brings samples and maps out the layout, from tile and porcelain to showerheads, lighting and storage.

steps.title: Order
steps.text: Materials are ordered directly from suppliers. Choosing items that are in stock helps keep the schedule short.

steps.title: Installation
steps.text: Jon and the install crew build the bathroom, keep the work area clean and do a final inspection before handing it back.

service_area.h2: From the Valley to North Central Arizona
service_area.text: AZ New Bath is based in Peoria and remodels bathrooms across the greater Phoenix area, from Glendale and Sun City to Scottsdale, Mesa and Gilbert. The crews also cover North Central Arizona, including Prescott, Prescott Valley, Sedona, Cottonwood, Jerome and Camp Verde, where the same low-maintenance porcelain and quick shower installs apply. The site lists these towns and says it serves the surrounding areas too, so if yours is not named, call and ask.

faq.h2: Bathroom remodel questions from Peoria and Phoenix homeowners

items.q: How long will my bathroom remodel take?
items.a: It depends on scope. AZ New Bath says shower remodels average 1 to 2 days and can be done in as little as one day. In an October 2026 post built from its own project schedules, the company put a complete primary bathroom remodel at around two weeks. Moving plumbing or special-order materials can add time.

items.q: Will I be without a working bathroom?
items.a: No. The company states that it will never leave you without running water or a toilet during a remodel. Crews also keep the work area clean as they go, and the site notes that its renovations are safe for pets. That makes it easier to stay in your home while the work is done.

items.q: What warranty comes with the work?
items.a: AZ New Bath offers a lifetime warranty on all of its remodels, covering products and services. It also guarantees satisfaction and says it will work with you until you are 100% happy. The company is licensed, bonded and insured under Arizona ROC #264481.

items.q: Do you offer financing or price matching?
items.a: Yes. The company's Phoenix bathroom remodel page lists 0% financing and a price match guarantee, along with transparent pricing and no hidden fees. Your quote is free and comes with no obligation, so you can compare it with other contractors before you decide.

items.q: Can you make a shower safer for an older parent?
items.a: Yes. AZ New Bath often installs walk-in showers and walk-in tubs with accessibility features for seniors and people with disabilities. Options include ramps, folding seats and easy wheelchair access. A tub-to-shower conversion removes the high step into the tub, which lowers the risk of a slip.

final_cta.text: Call (623) 281-3691 to set up a free in-home consultation. The team replies to every inquiry within 24 hours.
